desc:
Welcome to Ship Battles ⚓
 
How to Play: 
🚢 Place your ships secretly on the board. 
🎯 Take turns choosing coordinates to attack your opponent.
💥 Hit their ships and keep searching until you sink them all! 
🏆 Sink the entire enemy fleet to win! 

⚠️ Minimum of 2 players required to start! 
🌊 Prepare for battle and protect your fleet!
